name: runs_read

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

runId.description: Run id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [select: get, frontier, seats]

rootId.description: Only runs under this project root (a UUID or a hex prefix). [select: list]

status.description: Only runs in this status. [select: list]

endedSince.description: ISO 8601 instant: only runs that ended at or after it. [select: list]

unmarked.description: A mark key: only ended runs that do not carry this mark yet. [select: list]

itemId.description: Only the seats on this item (a UUID or a hex prefix). [select: seats]

ended.description: true: include ended seats; default only active ones. [select: seats]

cursor.description: The page.next value of the previous page. [select: list, seats]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Read runs. select: get (one run: budget, usage, coordinator liveness), list (a filtered page of runs), frontier (a run's ready, in-flight and waiting items) or seats (a run's seat assignments, tokens never shown). Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
